_what_this_is: Rules core.knowledge.kind_of() uses to LABEL a statement after intake (C-OC-3 Part 1d, 1 Oct 2026). First match wins, in this order. A label orders; it never removes: a sentence that matches nothing is kind 'other', which is valid and is stored and retrieved like any other.

rules.pattern: \b(is defined as|refers to|is the (share|number|percentage|proportion) of|means that|is a measure of)\b
